title: Kicky Gooey Thai Cod Gaeng Curry
description: A spicy and savory Thai curry dish featuring cod, perfect for a hangover cure, with a mustardy and gooey texture, diabetic-friendly and made in the style of Isaan cuisine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to dehydrate the cod fillets for 10 minutes
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the Thai red curry paste, cooking for 1 minute
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and dried mustard seeds to the pan, stirring to combine
Bring the curry mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened
Add the dehydrated cod fillets to the curry mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through
Serve the Kicky Gooey Thai Cod Gaeng Curry hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days
Reheat the curry mixture over low heat, adding a little water if necessary to achieve the desired consistency
